name: yaks
description: Filesystem-native task tracker. Plain markdown files, no yak left unshaved.

interface.shortDescription: Filesystem-native task tracker for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Yaks tracks work as markdown files with YAML frontmatter in a .yaks/ directory within your project. No database, no daemon — tasks are readable, diffable, and friendly to version control: commit .yaks/ to share a tracker with your team, or gitignore it for a private local-only scratchpad.
